problem: Scope must name the tempting expansions. Candidates below; each ticked one becomes an out node with its reason.

questions.text: Which are out of scope for this run?
questions.why: Each is something a unit could plausibly start on. An unticked item is not thereby in scope; it is undecided and I will ask.

options.value: The local web control surface that reads and writes the JSON documents (a later spec).
Migrating spec folders on other branches (constitution-research, engage-crew) to the layout.
CI configuration and any remote (GitHub Actions, PR automation).
Changing the spec schema, spec template, readiness rubric, rubric bench, and the spec/testing/versioning manuals — except where a registered problem names one (testing manuals, terms).
Installing anything: global commands, package.json, symlinks.
A judge runner for judged checks that calls a model (the check produces the sheet; the gate reads it).
The two build scripts under .claude/workflows/ from the v1 build: deleted or moved out of the harness folder as part of this run's cleanup.
